open_points.subject: show_port_refs
open_points.text: a SpooledFilesRef reads its SpooledFile records with SpooledFilesByKey with when_missing internal_error and each becomes ShownFile carrying its full SpooledFileKey and no value_id;
open_points.other_text: a SpooledFilesRef whose files are empty, a file list with no files, becomes a ShownPort with the same port name and no ShownItem, and makes no read.
open_points.question: Must an empty SpooledFilesRef call read_records as the first passage requires, or make no read as the second passage requires?
